AIIMG.RefPurpose.Label: Reference purpose (size sent)
AIIMG.RefPurpose.maxHint: 512 px: fine details (jewellery, lashes, brush texture). Most tokens.
AIIMG.RefPurpose.detailHint: 384 px: faces, eyes and details stay readable; about 44% fewer tokens than 512. Default for editing a character.
AIIMG.RefPurpose.styleHint: 304 px: enough for style, pose or palette; too little for a faithful face edit.
AIIMG.RefPurpose.colorHint: 208 px: only composition and colours survive.
AIIMG.RefSize.Rules: Every reference is shrunk in the browser before it is sent: never enlarged, sides in multiples of 16, never 513–1023 px (billed like 512), a source smaller than the chosen size drops to the next lower size. Sent as WebP (transparency kept). The original file is not changed.
AIIMG.RefSize.GenericNote: This provider gets the references as they are, only capped at 1536 px on the long side. Token estimates below apply to OpenAI GPT Image models only.
AIIMG.RefSize.Unknown: size unknown (the image could not be read)
AIIMG.RefSize.Wide: Wider than 3:1: the padding is billed too.
AIIMG.Est.Cheaper: {size} would be about {pct}% cheaper for the same quality (≈ {usd} less per image), if the frame allows it.
AIIMG.Est.Source: Token figures come from third-party measurements, not from OpenAI, and are not verified here; the log shows the real usage next to the estimate. Prices and the token table can be changed in the module settings. Batch costs half.
AIIMG.Settings.EstInPrice.Name: Estimate: image input price (USD per 1M tokens)
AIIMG.Settings.EstInPrice.Hint: Used only for the reference-image cost estimates shown in the windows (OpenAI GPT Image, sync rate; batch is half). Default 8. Real costs still come from the provider's usage.
AIIMG.Settings.EstOutPrice.Name: Estimate: image output price (USD per 1M tokens)
AIIMG.Settings.EstOutPrice.Hint: Used only for the output cost estimates shown in the windows (OpenAI GPT Image, sync rate; batch is half). Default 30.
AIIMG.Settings.EstOutTokens.Name: Estimate: output token table (JSON, optional)
AIIMG.Settings.EstOutTokens.Hint: Overrides the third-party output token figures, e.g. {"gpt-image-2.6":{"square":{"low":824},"wide":{"low":664}}}. square = 1024×1024, wide = 1536×1024. Leave empty for the built-in figures. Invalid JSON is ignored.
AIIMG.Tabs.Label: Settings sections
AIIMG.Depth.Banner: Add depth works in this browser (local model, free) or experimentally through an image model (paid, asks first). The parallax window and the ComfyUI engine are coming later.
AIIMG.Depth.Enabled: Add depth to this type's images
AIIMG.Depth.EnabledHint: Off by default. On: a depth button appears next to the image on sheets of this type. The browser engine runs locally and costs nothing; the generative engine is a paid image call and always asks first.
AIIMG.Depth.WebGPUYes: WebGPU is available in this browser.
AIIMG.Depth.WebGPUNo: No WebGPU in this browser: the default model is V2 Small (it also runs on the CPU, slower).
AIIMG.Depth.Fallback: Use V2 Small when WebGPU is missing or out of memory
AIIMG.Depth.ComfyUrlHint: Only localhost / 127.0.0.1 addresses are kept; anything else returns to http://127.0.0.1:8188. ComfyUI must run with --enable-cors-header.
AIIMG.Depth.SizesNote: Sizes from the Hugging Face file lists (research of 2026-11-18). A model downloads once on first use, after you confirm; the browser keeps it in its cache.
AIIMG.Depth.ModelNote.da2Large: Best detail in the V2 family, official Transformers.js support. Non-commercial licence (fine for a private module).
AIIMG.Depth.ModelNote.da2Small: Small and light, also runs without WebGPU (WASM). Softer edges.
AIIMG.Depth.ModelNote.da3OnnxExp: Newer generation; community ONNX export tested only outside the browser. Square input. Test it first.
AIIMG.Depth.ModelNote.da3Comfy: Native ComfyUI nodes (LoadDA3Model, DA3Inference). Sizes are our estimate. Gives depth, not disparity: inverted before the shader.
AIIMG.Depth.PrecisionHint: fp16: best quality on a GPU with shader-f16. q4f16: about 3× smaller download, may add noise in smooth areas. fp32: largest, for checks only.
AIIMG.Depth.ResolutionHint: Depth is computed at this size and scaled back to the image. Larger = more detail, slower. Experimental sizes are above the model's training size.
AIIMG.Depth.Mask: Sharpen the silhouette with a figure mask
AIIMG.Depth.MaskHint: Removes the halo around the figure; gives more than a bigger depth model.
AIIMG.Depth.MaskNote.toonout: BiRefNet tuned on anime figures, heavier; size and browser support not checked yet (test).
AIIMG.Depth.DilateHint: Outline pixels move with the figure instead of stretching with the background (2–4 px recommended).
AIIMG.Depth.GammaHint: Below 1 gives the face more depth range and the background less (0.7–0.9 for portraits).
AIIMG.Depth.FormatHint: Always lossless: WebP/JPEG blocks would turn into steps in the parallax.
AIIMG.Depth.MaskChannel: Save the mask with the depth (blue channel or a second file)
AIIMG.KeyStore.Hint: The keys are stored in this world for the GM only (a private folder on the server), so you do not type them again in another browser. Anyone with file access to the server, the world folder or a world backup can read them.
AIIMG.KeyStore.Conflict: This browser has a different key than the one stored in the world; this browser keeps using its own. Save to store the key shown here in the world.
AIIMG.KeyStore.NotLoaded: The keys stored in the world could not be read; this browser's own keys are used. Try again after reloading.
AIIMG.KeyStore.LoadFailed: AI Gen: the API keys stored in the world could not be read. This browser's own keys are used; the copy into the world will be tried again next time.
AIIMG.KeyStore.MigrateFailed: AI Gen: this browser's API keys could not be copied into the world. They are still here and still used; the copy will be tried again next time.
AIIMG.KeyStore.Migrated: AI Gen: this browser's API keys were copied into the world (GM only). The copy in this browser stays as it is.
AIIMG.KeyStore.SaveFailed: The API keys could not be saved in the world. Nothing was changed; try again.
AIIMG.KeyStore.WasPublic: AI Gen: the folder with the API keys had lost its private flag and was made private again. Consider replacing the keys.
AIIMG.Depth.GenWarn: Experimental: an image model draws a picture that looks like a depth map. It is not measured geometry: proportions can drift and near/far can be wrong. Every run is a paid call and asks first.
AIIMG.Depth.GenEstimate: Estimate for a 2:3 portrait: ~{usd} per depth map (output {w}×{h}, the image is sent at {rw}×{rh}).
AIIMG.Depth.GenConfirmHint: Each run shows the cost estimate and waits for your OK. Never automatic, never batch.
AIIMG.Depth.GenNoKey: No API key for this provider yet.
AIIMG.Depth.GenMaxLongHint: The depth image keeps the picture's shape: about 1 megapixel, sides in steps of 16, the longest side at most this value. A square gives 1024×1024, a 9:16 portrait 720×1280.
AIIMG.Depth.GenStyleRefHint: Off when empty. When set, this depth map is sent as a second image with an instruction to copy only its look, not its content. One more input image per run (in the estimate). In the owner's tests it changed little.
AIIMG.DepthRun.Title: Add depth
AIIMG.DepthRun.TryHint: Uses the settings below as they are now (also unsaved).
AIIMG.DepthRun.GenWarn: Experimental: an image model's depth is a drawing, not geometry (proportions may drift, near/far may be wrong). Paid: the estimate is shown before the call.
AIIMG.DepthRun.DlText: These model files are not in this browser yet. They download once from Hugging Face and stay in the browser cache:
AIIMG.DepthRun.DlLicence: Licences: Depth Anything V2 Large CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial), V2 Small Apache-2.0, BiRefNet lite MIT.
AIIMG.DepthRun.PaidExperimental: Experimental: an image model draws the depth map; proportions and near/far may be wrong.
AIIMG.DepthRun.PaidSize: Output {w}×{h}; your image is sent at {rw}×{rh}
AIIMG.DepthRun.Note.da3NotBuilt: Depth Anything 3 (ONNX) is not built yet: V2 Large was used.
AIIMG.DepthRun.Note.noShaderF16: This GPU has no shader-f16: fp32 was used.
AIIMG.DepthRun.Note.noWebGPUSmall: No WebGPU: V2 Small on the CPU (WASM) was used.
AIIMG.DepthRun.Note.maskNotBuilt: This mask model is not built yet: no mask.
AIIMG.DepthRun.Err.comfyNotBuilt: The ComfyUI engine is not built yet. Choose the browser engine.
AIIMG.DepthRun.Err.largeNeedsWebGPU: V2 Large needs WebGPU, which this browser does not have. Turn on the V2 Small fallback or pick V2 Small.
AIIMG.DepthRun.Err.notBrowserModel: The chosen model does not run in the browser.
AIIMG.DepthRun.Err.flat: The depth map came out flat (no depth difference).
AIIMG.DepthRun.Err.runtimeBroken: The model runtime of this page failed (GPU limit or memory). Reload the page (F5) and try again; details are in the console (F12).
AIIMG.DepthRun.Err.styleRef: The style example image could not be read. Check its path in the Depth settings or clear it.
AIIMG.DepthRun.Note.maskUnsupported: Figure mask skipped: BiRefNet lite does not run on this GPU (it needs 17 storage buffers per shader, this one allows fewer) and runs out of memory on the CPU. The depth map is made without it.
AIIMG.DepthRun.Note.metaKept: The old _depth.json next to the image was kept (the server does not overwrite it). The new map is saved and its format is recorded in the depth index.
AIIMG.PortraitParallax.Setting.Name: Depth parallax on actor portraits
AIIMG.PortraitParallax.Setting.Hint: When an actor's image has a depth map, its portrait in the actor sheet moves in 3D with the mouse. Players see it too (the map is a plain file). Off: portraits stay flat. Respects the reduced-motion setting of the system and switches itself off on a computer where it slows frames down.
AIIMG.PortraitParallax.Slow: Portrait parallax switched off on this computer for now: frames were too slow. It comes back after reloading the page.
AIIMG.Parallax.Title: Portrait window (parallax)
AIIMG.Parallax.Stage: Parallax preview. Move the pointer over it; arrow keys move the view (Shift = small steps), Home centres it.
AIIMG.Parallax.KeysHint: Pointer or arrow keys move the view; it sways by itself after a moment.
AIIMG.Parallax.NoWebGL: This browser has no WebGL2, so the parallax window cannot draw. The depth files are not affected.
AIIMG.Parallax.GLFailed: The parallax shader failed to start: {error}
AIIMG.Parallax.Aspect: map proportions differ from the image
